description: Cost: 1 date + 1 shared daily date; preview: true spends nothing. When both wanted to see each other again, book their second date, where they agreed by text. The first date must have aired. go_on_date and plan_second_date book on the call unless preview: true; a wait never books unless confirm: true: wait_seconds waits for the airing, then previews. Pass episode_id, or character_id and with.

confirm.description: With wait_seconds: book once it airs (a wait alone only previews).

preview.description: true: where it stands and the cost, and nothing is started or spent.

visibility.description: public: feed, airs, points. unlisted: link only, airs. private: owners only, never airs, no second date.

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for the first date to air, then preview (0: answer now; your move wakes it).
